definitions.explanation: Decorative paper or material applied to interior walls for aesthetic purposes.

definitions.gloss: wallpaper; background image (on a computer or phone screen)
definitions.explanation: The background image displayed on a computer desktop or smartphone home screen.

examples.japanese: {壁紙|かべがみ}を{張|は}り{替|か}える。
{新|あたら}しい{壁紙|かべがみ}にしたら{部屋|へや}が{明|あか}るくなった。
examples.english: The room brightened up after we put up new wallpaper.

examples.japanese: {花柄|はながら}の{壁紙|かべがみ}を{選|えら}んで、リビングの{雰囲気|ふんいき}を{変|か}えた。
examples.english: I chose a floral wallpaper and changed the atmosphere of the living room.

examples.japanese: スマホの{壁紙|かべがみ}を{変|か}えた。
{好|す}きな{写真|しゃしん}をパソコンの{壁紙|かべがみ}に{設定|せってい}した。
examples.english: I set my favorite photo as my computer wallpaper.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}ごとにスマホの{壁紙|かべがみ}を{変|か}えるのが{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: It's fun to change my phone wallpaper with each season.

notes:
USAGE:
The original meaning refers to physical wallpaper for interior decoration. The digital sense (desktop/phone background) has become equally common in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁紙|かべがみ}を{張|は}る (to put up wallpaper)
- {壁紙|かべがみ}を{変|か}える (to change the wallpaper)
- {壁紙|かべがみ}を{設定|せってい}する (to set as wallpaper)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クロス: cross, cloth wallcovering — used by professionals for vinyl wallcoverings
- {背景|はいけい}: background — broader term for any background
